title: Promote validated community knowledge
summary: Community AL best practice articles are promoted to Microsoft-endorsed knowledge, removing duplicates and overlapping guidance while updating review skills with canonical references.
key_points: Eight AppSource, UI, error-handling and security articles promoted from the community layer to the Microsoft layer, with their samples
Six covered or overlapping community articles removed; FactBox and IsTemporary guidance stays in the community layer
Corrected the Copilot help URL version gate, split-button recommendations and encrypted isolated storage nuances
Review-skill tokens, examples and references updated to match the cleaned corpus
Telemetry review now uses its empty-corpus result, since telemetry scope is covered by Microsoft privacy guidance
quote: Consolidating them reduces retrieval noise and gives review skills canonical paths and discovery signals.
